svg.title: Belief-space MPC: cost decomposition
svg.desc: Published double-integrator means over 10 trials at H=15. State and input cost components for Sep, Sep-MPC, and B-MPC. B-MPC lowers total cost by 38.8 percent against Sep in this setting. Source: Table 2, arXiv:2604.24663v1.
